answer: Proof-of-typing-cadence defeats paste farms. Each answer must carry a log of inter-keystroke intervals showing the bursty, irregular rhythm of a human composing, not the flat instant-paste of a script. A copper-smooth wall of cloned posts shares one identical timing and is rejected. A script cannot fake the gale of human pauses between words, and a shale of near-identical cadences collapses into one fingerprint. To pass, an attacker must type or simulate N distinct human rhythms per wallet, paying real wall-clock time, since bulk pasting earns nothing.
